programs.title: Path operations never touch the disk

programs.takeaway: Path methods are pure text operations: normalize removes . and .., resolve joins, relativize builds the route between two paths.

programs.title: Dates are immutable

steps.note: plusDays returns a new LocalDate; the result is thrown away.
February 2024 has no 31st, so the day is clamped to the last valid day, the 29th.
The clamped day 29 is kept: not March 31.

programs.takeaway: java.time objects are immutable: always use the returned value. plusMonths clamps to the end of a shorter month.
